main.description: Record the caller DID's next epoch head. Accepted only if its number is 0 or the latest + 1, its previousEpochHead is the stored head, the head recomputes, and a current chat device of the DID attested it. Identical bytes succeed again. Directory endpoint: any authenticated chat device may call it. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
